messages:
alex m: Quick follow-up on the Peregrine postmortem. Main buckets: VPC peering blips -> controller race -> stale routes. Need owners, dates, and verification plan.

maria g: I'll own vendor/network coordination. Talk to router vendor about graceful-peering flag and firmware. Target initial vendor writeup by 2026-04-03.

sanjay r: I'll own controller fixes: add per-peer sync lock, debounce route cleanup, and safelist for recently restarted peers. Plan: repro in staging, RFC, PR + tests. PR ETA 2026-04-08.

julia ops: I'll run canary and observability changes: 2 staging tenants, synthetic flap generator, new Grafana panels (peering_flap_rate, route_staleness). Canary start 2026-04-10.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary-cluster provisioned at 1734570000, metrics and logs enabled.

sanjay r: Repro note: sequence is peer drop -> rapid reconnect during KV apply -> overlapping sync. Log sample: ```WARN isolation-controller: overlapping-kv-sync detected; deferred cleanup``` 
I will attach repro script and traces to RW-8110.

alex m: Short-term mitigation: safelist peers restarted within 5m and reduce aggressive prune. Sanjay please include latency/cost tradeoffs in RFC.

maria g: Vendor confirms firmware v1.2.8 improves backoff handling; enabling graceful-peering requires a restart in a maintenance window. I'll propose windows to customer.

julia ops: Added recurring alert: if flap_count >3 in 24h, auto-create incident and tag oncall; also weekly peering digest.

alex m: Closing criteria: merged controller fix + 72h clean canary + firmware applied or validated fallback. Tentative close date 2026-04-15. Drop blockers here and update the action tracker.
